name: Depression
overview: Scripture reveals that God is intimately aware of human sorrow and depression, as demonstrated in His compassionate care for Hagar and her son in the wilderness, where He not only hears their cries but provides sustenance and assurance of His presence (Genesis 21:17-20). Likewise, the profound grief of Jacob mourning for Joseph shows the depth of human sorrow, yet even in such pain, there is a community that seeks to comfort, though true solace comes from God alone (Genesis 37:34-35). These passages affirm that while depression and grief are real and deeply felt, God’s attentive love and provision remain steadfast amid our trials.
